title: Measuring Bias in AI Models: An Statistical Approach Introducing N-Sigma
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measures performance differences (bias) of face recognition models across different ethnic/racial demographic groups (Caucasian, Indian, Asian, African).
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion. Its key findings are that distribution-based metrics, particularly the proposed N-Sigma method, are more interpretable and user-friendly for quantifying bias in AI models compared to pointwise metrics or traditional T-Tests. The experiments focused exclusively on racial bias in face recognition.
